messages.subject: killing a multithread stan run
parts:
I’m in R, I run Stan, and it’s taking forever. I hit Esc and so on but the 4 processes in background still are running. Is there any way to kill my Stan run without killing my R session?
A

messages.author: 743bbacc59f4b25f
messages.subject: Re: killing a multithread stan run
parts:
On Wednesday, April 27, 2016 at 9:57:19 PM UTC-4, Andrew Gelman wrote:
I’m in R, I run Stan, and it’s taking forever.  I hit Esc and so on but the 4 processes in background still are running.  Is there any way to kill my Stan run without killing my R session?

Execute

system("killall R")

which ironically does not take down the RStudio R process.

Ben

messages.author: 15a4b17f7f9c7f0a
messages.subject: Re: killing a multithread stan run
parts:
Thanks for asking this. I've been wondering myself for a while. System("killall R") didn't seem to work for me though. Rscript.exe continues to run and I get this in R(studio):

> system("killall R")
Warning message:
running command 'killall R' had status 127 

Did this work for you Andrew?

For what it is worth, after some googling, I did actually get it to work with:

system("taskkill /im Rscript.exe /f")


And I haven't noticed any ill effects to my R session so far as I can tell. 

Best,

-Roy
